purpose: Show that alternative finite runtime carrier models encode the same presentation-independent invariant meaning when they faithfully represent the same canonical invariant carrier.

model_semantics.complete_faithful_carrier_model: Every canonical carrier element has exactly one model image and distinct canonical carrier elements remain distinct inside the model.
model_semantics.partial_carrier_model: At least one canonical carrier element has no model image; model equivalence remains held open.
model_semantics.carrier_model_obstructed: The model collapses distinct invariant carrier elements or violates the finite carrier representation contract.

pair_semantics.same_invariant_carrier_meaning: Two complete faithful models are in finite runtime bijection through the same canonical invariant carrier.
pair_semantics.carrier_model_equivalence_held: At least one model is partial.
pair_semantics.carrier_model_equivalence_obstructed: At least one model fails to preserve distinct canonical invariant meanings.

next: carry runtime semantics only on the invariant carrier, and treat all complete faithful carrier models as replaceable presentations of that carrier
